title: Ловушка "To Be" (Been vs Gone)
description: Разница между "он уехал и вернулся" (been) и "он уехал и там" (gone).

items.question: My dad isn't here. He has ___ to Rome.
I know London well. I have ___ there twice.
Mary is on holiday. She has ___ to Spain.
We have ___ to this museum before, let's go somewhere else.
Where is Tom? He has ___ to the bank.
